steps: Assess creative workforce for fiction human capital & development using BLS and cultural employment data
Design talent strategy with education, mentorship, affordable workspace, and healthcare

treatments.monitoring: PHASE 1 (Weeks 1-4): Baseline — artists employment rate using labor force cultural survey. Deliverable: baseline report. PHASE 2 (Months 2-3): Early tracking — artists employment rate measured annually. Target: creative workforce growth 5%. PHASE 3 (Months 4-6): Midpoint review — compare against BLS arts employment benchmark. Target: 50% of goal. PHASE 4 (Months 7-12): Maturation — artists employment rate trending toward 8% growth.
